source_refs.note: 'Critical Region' under topic 7.3, as printed (PDF 96, printed 92).

blocks.text: The critical region is a range of values. If test statistics fall in this region, the null hypothesis is rejected. It is defined before testing. The region depends on the significance level. It shows extreme outcomes. Critical regions help make decisions. They reduce uncertainty. Graphs often show critical regions. Understanding this concept is important.
